key: Agh-- I knew I shouldn't have eaten that...
en: Agh-- I knew I shouldn't have eaten that...
ja: うっ……あんなもの食べるんじゃなかった……

key: Free meal in a box like that--
en: Free meal in a box like that--
ja: あんな弁当の無料メシ――

key: I practically walked into The Spyce and ordered a side of 'Too Good To Be True' to go.
en: I practically walked into The Spyce and ordered a side of 'Too Good To Be True' to go.
ja: ザ・スパイスに足を運んで、『できすぎた話』を持ち帰り注文したようなものだったな。

key: Food poisoning for sure--
en: Food poisoning for sure--
ja: 確実に食中毒だ――

key: Hey, Trainer--
en: Hey, Trainer--
ja: おい、トレーナー――

key: You got an antidote on you?
en: You got an antidote on you?
ja: どくけし、持ってないか?

key: Don't suppose you could part with one for an ailing soul?
en: Don't suppose you could part with one for an ailing soul?
ja: 病人のために、一つ分けてもらえたりしないか?

key: \PN handed over the Antidote.
en: \PN handed over the Antidote.
ja: \PNはどくけしを渡した。

key: Wow...
en: Wow...
ja: うわぁ……

key: I don't know what to say...
en: I don't know what to say...
ja: 何て言えばいいか……

key: Other than "thanks," of course, but I don't have much to give you.
en: Other than "thanks," of course, but I don't have much to give you.
ja: 「ありがとう」以外に言葉がないな。でも、大したものは返せないんだ。

key: Ah-- Actually, I know just what to say:
en: Ah-- Actually, I know just what to say:
ja: ああ――そうだ、いいことを教えてやろう。

key: "antidote".
en: "antidote".
ja: 「antidote」だ。

key: Next time someone asks you for a password, tell them "antidote".
en: Next time someone asks you for a password, tell them "antidote".
ja: 今度誰かに合言葉を聞かれたら、「antidote」って言うといい。

key: That'll stop you and your party from taking Poison damage while walking around.
en: That'll stop you and your party from taking Poison damage while walking around.
ja: そうすりゃ、歩いてる間にパーティが毒のダメージを受けなくなるんだ。

key: Learn your lesson from me, kid, you don't want none of this.
en: Learn your lesson from me, kid, you don't want none of this.
ja: 俺を反面教師にしとけ、坊主。こんな目に遭いたくないだろ。

key: Thank you for the kindness though; I'm sure I'll be right as rain in a few ticks.
en: Thank you for the kindness though; I'm sure I'll be right as rain in a few ticks.
ja: でも親切には感謝するよ。少し経てばすぐに元気になるさ。

key: Every man for himself, I get it...
en: Every man for himself, I get it...
ja: 自分の身は自分で守れ、ってやつだよな……わかるよ……

key: No sweat, I've learned my lesson on expecting freebies to pan out anyway...
en: No sweat, I've learned my lesson on expecting freebies to pan out anyway...
ja: 気にすんな、どうせタダのものに期待するもんじゃないって、いい勉強になったし……

key: I'll-- be fine...
en: I'll-- be fine...
ja: 俺なら……大丈夫だ……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
